name: 73162 · Oklahoma City, OK
findings: ZIP 73162 (Oklahoma City) has 87 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73162 (Oklahoma City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 73162 (Oklahoma City) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).
